result.title: Creativity is a team sport | Walter Isaacson & Kent Walker
result.description:
Is innovation a solo pursuit? In this episode of Dialogues, bestselling author Walter Isaacson joins Kent Walker, Alphabet and Google President of Global Affairs, to explore how history’s greatest breakthroughs depended on collaboration, shared curiosity, and storytelling, and what that means for the AI era of today.

Together, they discuss how teamwork across disciplines drives technological progress, the role of human creativity alongside new tools, and how thoughtful innovation can shape technology for the benefit of society.

Chapters:
00:00 - Introductions
00:41 - The 50 year cycle of innovation
01:46 - Creativity is a team sport
02:27 - The Ada Lovelace school of thought
03:35 - Standing at the intersection of the humanities and technology
04:49 - Using Gemini Notebook for writing
05:22 - The J curve impact of AI tools
08:17 - What human agency can bring to AI
